overall: The AG found the Commission did not violate the Open Meeting Law by holding its September 9, 2010 litigation executive session, found its minutes accurate, but reminded it to approve minutes timely.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Commission held an unannounced executive session on September 9, 2010.
allegations.key_passage: From the evidence we reviewed, we believe that the Commission did in fact post notice of its executive session ahead of its September 9, 2010 meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Commission entered executive session for litigation strategy without showing an open meeting would harm its litigating position.
allegations.key_passage: Holding that discussion in open session would have had a detrimental effect on the Commission's litigating position.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged no public record showed who attended, what was discussed, or whether any vote was taken at the September 9, 2010 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We reviewed both the open and executive session minutes of the Commission's September 9, 2010 meeting, and find the minutes to be accurate and complete.

allegations.summary: AG noted the September 9, 2010 open session minutes were not created and approved timely, released about eighteen months later; raised by AG, not the complainant.
allegations.key_passage: We note that the minutes of the Commission's September 9, 2010 open session were not created and approved in a timely manner, as they were released a year and a half after the meeting occurred.

allegations.summary: Commission argued the complaint was untimely under the 30-day filing window; AG declined to so find and reached the merits.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to the find the complaint untimely because the Commission did not publicly release the open session minutes of its September 9, 2010 meeting until after this complaint was filed

remedy: Reminder to create and approve minutes of its meetings in a timely manner in accordance with G.L. c. 30A, § 22
remedy_passage: We remind the Commission of its obligation to create and approve minutes of its meeting in a timely manner in accordance with G.L. c. 30A, § 22.
